name: slider
title: Slider
description: A field control — the thesis test of the control/body rule for a non-text control. Carries no border, background, height, focus ring or invalid state of its own; all of that arrives from field.row. The Control carries the field-control marker so the row's outline fires on focus. The thumb's own focus ring uses palette-ring. Range sliders work with the same component. Uses the track family (rail + fill). Installing after progress writes exactly one file.
